attr.title: PartyBoard
attr.desc: Native Mario Party 4 reimplementation for NextOS AArch64 and Mali-450 OpenGL ES 2.0. Full boards and minigames, four-player controls, music, sound effects, saves and clean Select+Start exit.
attr.inst: Place your supported Mario Party 4 (GMPE01) USA .rvz/.iso/.gcm image in partyboard/assets.
